From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>

Subject: Close-window signals — top stale opportunities for immediate handback

Team,

Quick hygiene ask ahead of EOW forecasting: our signals flagged a set of OrthoHealth opportunities with aging stages and close dates that are likely to skew commit unless we either reclassify or confirm revised close dates. I pulled the top 8 by ARR and attached a small CSV (stale-opps-report.csv) plus the current mutual action plan (MAP-OrthoHealth.docx).

High level ask (please do not delay):
- Marissa: review the list and mark 'commit / push / archive' in SF for each opp by EOD Wednesday (2026-11-04). Prioritize deals with Close Date <= 2026-11-30 and Stage in {Opportunity, Negotiation}.
- Ben: help validate any push requests that look reasonable and add a one-line rationale in the opp notes (especially if negotiation is progressing but legal is the blocker).

If Samir has updates on timing or blockers, please reply inline so we can capture an exact close-date or set a realistic next-step. If we don't get confirmations, we will move stale items to "Commit: No" for forecasting and re-open as active when the customer signals again.

Why this matters: finance needs a defensible commit set for Friday’s forecast review. A small number of high-ARR orphans here could materially inflate our projected commit.

Thanks — I’ll be on Slack for quick clarifications.

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Hannah,

Thanks for the heads up and for pulling this together. Quick notes from my side after a first pass:

- ORTH-503 (42k ARR): stalled; leadership asked for an ROI addendum before signing — likely Q1. Recommend archive/convert to sandbox opp until we get a new ask.
- ORTH-476 (8k ARR): pilot complete, we need to confirm production timeline with IT next week. Tentative close 2026-12-10.

I can confirm the liability review is scheduled for 11/18; I don't expect we can get earlier. If you need an official note, I can loop in our procurement lead.
